prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / educational onboarding overlay.
Create ONE polished Chinese desktop onboarding overlay bitmap for the EXISTING Figo Agent Trace Inspector, landscape 16:10, high resolution, suitable as a single full-screen dismissible guide image.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is the actual Trace Inspector acceptance screenshot and is the authoritative UI background: preserve its full-page toolbar, event list on LEFT, detail pane on RIGHT, actual seven detail tabs (总览、上下文流、模型请求、模型响应、工具调用、压缩、原始 JSON). Preserve the actual tab order and broad layout. Do not redesign the app or invent functionality. Existing tiny fixture text can remain subdued and need not be legible. No private credentials.
INPUT IMAGE 2 is ONLY the visual style reference of an earlier onboarding overlay. Match its neutral charcoal translucent dimming over real UI, crisp bold white Chinese sans-serif headings, turquoise numbered circular badges, and restrained white curved leader arrows. Do NOT copy its workbench background or its onboarding steps. This new image is dedicated entirely to the standalone Trace Inspector, not the small chat inspector drawer.
COMPOSITION: title near upper center with generous spacing, then five clearly separated numbered callouts distributed across the dimmed screenshot. Each has one short bold heading and at most two short supporting lines. Leader arrows must point to the actual corresponding UI control, not arbitrary background. Keep the detail tab strip visible and outlined unobtrusively where needed. Do not place text on top of other text; keep all callouts, arrows, and footer separate. Make all newly added Chinese text large, exact, highly readable at 1440 desktop width. No floating cards, no gradients, no ornaments, no decorative fake graphs, no phone frames.
EXACT OVERLAY COPY:
Title: "Trace Inspector 核心功能"
Subtitle: "像查抓包一样，复盘 Agent 的每一步"
Small entry hint under subtitle: "入口：工作台右上角的波形图标"
1 heading "先锁定任务"
support "选择任务、搜索事件；勾选「仅失败」快速排查。"
arrow points to top-left task selector and failure checkbox.
2 heading "沿时间线追踪"
support "点击左侧事件，查看对应详情。"
second short line "按顺序定位模型、工具与上下文记录。"
arrow points to selected row in LEFT event table.
3 heading "看清发出与返回"
support "「模型请求」看发送内容，「模型响应」看返回内容。"
second short line "核对消息、工具定义、状态与用量。"
arrow points to model request/response tabs in RIGHT pane.
4 heading "弄清上下文与压缩"
support "「上下文流」看来源，「压缩」看过程和摘要。"
second short line "对照保留内容与压缩前后记录。"
two short leader arrows point to context flow tab and compaction tab respectively.
5 heading "排查工具与原始数据"
support "「工具调用」看入参、结果和错误。"
second short line "「原始 JSON」核对记录，顶部可导出脱敏数据。"
arrow points to tool calls/raw JSON tab area; optional additional thin arrow to existing export icon.
Footer centered: "点击任意位置关闭引导"
Accuracy: no claims of exposing hidden chain-of-thought, no claim every event has measured Token usage, no fabricated performance savings. Do not add an executable close button inside the picture, the whole image will be dismissible in a future implementation. No other new text.
